dialog.name: Name
dialog.nameHint: Leave it empty and the start of the instruction becomes the name.
dialog.instructionHint: What the agent should do — just as you would write it in the chat
dialog.newConversationHint: A separate conversation for every trigger — for independent reports.
dialog.thisConversationHint: The agent sees its earlier replies and can compare with last time.
dialog.onlyNewConversationHint: To get replies in one conversation, ask the agent there: “/” → “Schedule”.

access.label: Access
access.readHint: The agent searches and reads. It makes no writes — tickets, emails, data changes — and says so in its reply.
access.fullHint: The agent makes writes without your confirmation, within your rights. Your consent is needed below.
access.consent: I understand: on this schedule the agent itself creates and changes records on my behalf — tickets, emails, data in systems — and does not ask for confirmation. It may also make a write from text it read in an email or a ticket.
access.consentHint: To give full access, tick the consent.

errors.instruction: Write what the agent should do.
errors.past: This time has passed — choose a future one.
errors.time: Enter the time as HH:MM, from 00:00 to 23:59.
errors.hours: Enter a whole number of hours from 1 to {max, number}.

list.title: Schedules
list.emptyHint: Create one with “New schedule” or write in any conversation what to do and when — the agent will set up the schedule.

page.pausedDeleted: The conversation “{title}” was deleted, so the schedule is paused. To make it work again, choose replies in a new conversation and resume it.

notices.conversationGone: The conversation “{title}” was deleted — there is nowhere to send. Choose replies in a new conversation.

deleteDialog.title: Delete the schedule?
deleteDialog.body: The schedule “{name}” will not trigger again. The conversations it wrote to stay in the list.

history.title: Trigger history
history.openLabel: Open the conversation of the trigger at {at}

card.accessDropped: Full access removed: the schedule now only reads. You can give it back in the form — “Open”.
